q: How does a Genome Valley pharma unit count its cold room electricity?
title: Pharma cold rooms: electricity count
short: Cold room power is part of your Scope 2: kWh times 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh. If the cold room has its own meter, report it separately so you can see what storage costs per pallet or per batch.
audience: Vaccine and biologics makers in the Genome Valley cluster near Hyderabad, Telangana

p: Sub-meter kWh for cold rooms, or estimate from rated load and hours, labelled as an estimate.
Diesel for generators that protect the cold chain is Scope 1 at 2.68 kg CO2 per litre.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.

sources.label: CEA CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector
